changes.comment: Upgrade to Fastify 5, Connect 2, and Protobuf-ES 2. Clients now use the Connect `Client` type and always use HTTP/2; the `httpVersion` option is removed.
Adapt remote execution to Connect 2 and Protobuf-ES 2.
Use the native `os.availableParallelism()` API on supported Node.js versions.
Refresh the API report for Node.js 24 typings.
